name: Shoko Relay
overview: A custom metadata provider and automation toolset for integrating Plex and AnimeThemes with Shoko Server.

releases.release_notes:
This is the largest release in quite some time and is primarily dedicated to adding support for movie libraries in Plex.

**Changes:**
- Added dedicated Plex Movie library support (tv.plex.agents.custom.shoko.movie scheme) with standalone Movie VFS generation (!ShokoRelayMovieVFS)
- Added m{id} movie rating keys, movie GUID resolution, and movie library support across matching, metadata, and agent endpoints
- Implemented unique TMDB poster selection, sort titles, and prioritized episode descriptions for multi-part movies
- Updated watched state, scrobble, webhook, critic ratings, image sync, and empty trash automation to natively support Movie library sections
- Expanded VFS Browser to render, merge, and navigate Movie branches, local extra subdirectories, and direct metadata links
- Added zero-width and hair space formatting to Opening and Ending extra titles to bypass Plex's automatic prefix truncation
- Refined theme selection priority (lowest-numbered OP -> lowest-numbered ED) and added ED upgrade checks to the MP3 audit tool
- Updated Collection Build, Discovery, and Task Reports to segregate TV Shows and Movie libraries, including tracking deleted empty collections (REMOVED:)
- Automatically strip trailing AniDB moderator comments (--) from tag names in TagHelper
- Added Cache-Control headers to VFS tree endpoint responses to prevent stale browser caching
- Optimized database lookups in MetadataController match logic and performed general code cleanups and documentation updates
- Updated README/Controller.md with details on the new functionality

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.16.9...v0.17.0

**Changes:**
- Add ImportFolderExclusions to AdvancedConfig to allow users to prevent VFS generation in specific import folders (by Name or ID) without hiding the media from Shoko
- Standardize logging so series titles, episode number, shoko ids and plex rating keys are listed when available
- Remove premature Dispose() calls from the main thread in ScheduleDebouncedAction and VfsWatcher.Stop()
- Let background tasks handle their own CancellationTokenSource disposal in their finally blocks to prevent crashes when file events arrive rapidly
- Execute RunCollectionUpdateAsync directly inside RunMetadataFixupAsync to ensure collections are processed strictly after VFS rebuilds and Plex scans complete
- Wrap subsequent API tasks in foundInAnyTarget to bypass redundant execution if Plex has not yet recognized the series
- Rename references to 'Import Folders' to 'Managed Folders'
- Add an early return in VfsWatcher.TriggerPlexUpdates if the series has no valid VFS paths
- Inline single-use helper methods across the project excluding PlexMetadata
- Update ConfigProvider.cs with missing XML documentation for private fields, methods, properties, and nested classes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.16.8...v0.16.9

**Changes:**
- Add GetDisplayTitle extension method to TextHelper.cs to resolve series titles using plugin language settings and ensure all task reports and console logs use it
- Extract redundant Plex update logic from ShokoController and delegate it entirely to VfsWatcher (adds media analysis and critic/image sync support to manual vfs refreshes)
- Update GetLog endpoint in DashboardController to serve text/plain; charset=utf-8
- Group Sync Watched change details by user and library
- Remove episode titles from log reports

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.16.7...v0.16.8

**Changes:**
- Add AnalyzeItemAsync to PlexClient to trigger the Plex media analysis endpoint and run it during Plex metadata fixup tasks
- Detect when previously cached local posters, backdrops, logos, or episode thumbnails are removed from disk and remove them from the cache and shoko's db
- Fix ConcurrentBags not being returned at the end of SyncImagesAsync, which caused local series artwork uploads and errors to be omitted from the report log
- Check if cacheVal is null to differentiate between a newly discovered local image and an existing one that changed on disk
- Update ImageSyncService/SyncToShoko to respect TMDB numbering in their logs if enabled
- Update SyncToShoko to use incoming Plex item metadata indexes for accurate logging
- Format season and episode numbers in logs uniformly to D2 (e.g., S01E01)
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to 6.0.0-alpha.77

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.16.6...v0.16.7
